title: github-pr-explorer shorthands
description: shorthands.json in the configuration folder (~/Library/Application Support/github-pr-explorer/config): short names the app draws in place of repositories and people, such as Web for acme/web. Display only: titles, descriptions, comments, links, copied values and anything sent to GitHub are unchanged. A missing file means no shorthands. The app's Settings window and `github-pr-explorer-ctl shorthands` write this file. A key not listed here makes the file invalid, and the app keeps using the last version that worked. Two shorthands for the same thing also make it invalid, which this schema cannot check. Two things that share one shorthand are allowed, with a warning.

$schema.description: Optional. A link to this schema, for editors. The app ignores it.

formatVersion.description: The version of this file's format. This app reads version 1 only.

shorthands.description: Every shorthand, in any order. Each matches its thing exactly, ignoring case. There are no patterns.

kind.description: What the shorthand stands for: repository, matched by owner/name, or person, matched by login.

for.description: The thing's identity: owner/name for a repository, such as acme/web, or the login for a person, such as ada-park, without @.

shorthand.description: What the app draws instead of the full name. Hovering it shows the full name.
